assets.name: 300w
assets.prompt: Use case: background-extraction and precise-object-edit. EDIT TARGET: supplied original product photograph. Extract the actual MAIN black 300W video light in the center/lower right of this image as a clean transparent product photograph, preserving its exact pixels/physical identity. Remove only branding and surrounding infographic/background. Keep same three-quarter camera viewpoint, exact horizontally elongated rectangular ribbed body proportions, raised rear carry handle, round silver front emitter plate with narrow vertical yellow LED, black round Bowens mount ring, side knob shape, silver horizontal edge stripe, exact U-shaped bracket and lower cylindrical mount. Remove red/white APKINA logo, AP Series wording and any markings from side face, replacing only those printed areas with the surrounding original dark surface. Do not alter proportions, silhouette, design, texture or shape. Exclude all accessory objects at top, dotted arc, text labels and bottom-left circular magnified inset. The product should be alone with complete bottom mount and natural photograph detail. Pure true alpha transparent background, no white backdrop, no shadow plane. Product centered with modest transparent margin. This is surgical photo cleanup, not new CGI and not a redesign. Preserve the original object angle and geometry. No logo, no lettering, no extra features.
assets.qa: Compared visually with supplied main photograph: same angle, ribbed horizontal body, round front face/emitter, handle, outlined side knob, yoke and mount. Branding and surrounding diagram removed.
